stage.name: Tiny Bridge
stage.type: Challenge stage (sixth; unlocked by reaching level 80 in Inverse Gallo Tower, or the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane spell 'recyclethetower'; hyper mode unlocked by default)
stage.spawn_type: Narrow bridge: enemies mostly approach from the left and right sides in large clusters

modifiers.scaling_note: Effects text: enemy health multiplier +0.2 per minute and enemy speed multiplier +0.025 per minute (additive). The infobox reads 'enemy-speed per min = +0.25', which contradicts the effects text; 0.025 used as the more plausible value.

stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox fields; blank luck/projectile fields assumed 1. Hyper mode (x1.9 player/enemy speed, x1.15 projectile speed, greed x1.8, luck x1.1, 50 starting spawns) not needed here.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

relics.position: far left of the bridge, past Wings and Vento Sacro

stage_items.yellow_sign_note: The Yellow Sign has no effect on this stage.

stage.destructibles: Wiki gives destructible chance 7.5% (max 50%), max 10; type not stated (assume light sources).

layout.orientation: horizontal (east-west): the bridge runs left-right; enemies come from the left and right sides
layout.width_note: Width not given numerically; wiki calls it an 'incredibly narrow layout'. Trivia: a well-timed pause while running against the north or south walls lets the player escape the bridge (returning to the map without enemies; 'I AM ALIVE HERE' text far north/south).
layout.size_note: Long and narrow horizontal bridge, exact length unknown; weapons on both ends and the Chaos Altemanna relic at the far left end.
layout.obstacles: None described; walls along the north and south edges of the bridge.
layout.theme: Small stone bridge (music theme Roaring Thunder); stormy setting between two opposing factions that stopped fighting.
layout.special_mechanics: Challenge stage. Enemies grow stronger over time: enemy health multiplier +0.2 per minute, enemy speed +0.025 per minute (infobox says +0.25, see modifiers.scaling_note). Item drops are NOT disabled. Stage weapons: Wings and Vento Sacro on the left, Attractorb and Lightning Ring on the right; Chaos Altemanna relic far left. Shooting Star and Monster Rain map events. Yellow Sign has no effect. Reaper at 20:00 clears the screen, one more Reaper per minute after.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: Gallo Tower minute-25 Giant Enemy Crab chest lists no level (fallback_level omitted); Drowner (crab summon) chest also exists but is not tabulated. Tier chances copied verbatim from the wave table (tier3=5-item, tier2=3-item, tier1=1-item).
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 20:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
